races.name: Bet 30 Get 5 Weekly betstgeorge.com Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This three-runner affair lacks a genuine front runner, creating a tactical conundrum. Broomfield Aderra is the only horse with confirmed prominent tendencies but has also raced from behind, making his approach uncertain. Ka Mate Du Brivet's running style remains unknown due to limited experience. With Willshebe Court preferring hold-up tactics, someone must go forward early or face an awkward crawling pace. Expect Broomfield Aderra to reluctantly take up the running but at a pedestrian gallop, setting up a dash from the final hurdle where stamina and acceleration from an unpressured position become crucial.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**Broomfield Aderra** faces the thankless task of making the running in a small field, likely finding himself isolated in front and vulnerable to challengers with superior finishing kicks. His even-pace profile means he'll struggle if others quicken late. **Ka Mate Du Brivet** could benefit significantly if sitting second throughout - the highest-rated runner can travel into the race and use superior class late. **Willshebe Court** typically needs a strong pace to aim at but may find the tactical nature suits his hold-up style, though the going concern on good ground remains a major question mark having never raced in these conditions.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) **If Ka Mate Du Brivet takes up prominent position early** - Broomfield Aderra and Willshebe Court benefit because the pace becomes more genuine, suiting Willshebe Court's hold-up style while preventing Ka Mate Du Brivet from using his class advantage late.

B) **If the pace crawls for the first mile** - Ka Mate Du Brivet benefits because he can sit off the modest gallop and unleash superior acceleration in the straight, while Broomfield Aderra and Willshebe Court suffer from the tactical finish.

C) **If Willshebe Court handles the good ground well** - Willshebe Court benefits because he gets the slowly-run race his hold-up style craves, while Broomfield Aderra suffers most from being picked off late having done the donkey work in front.

## WATCH POINTS

Monitor **Willshebe Court** in the preliminaries for any signs of confidence on unfamiliar good ground - trainer/jockey body language crucial given his complete lack of form on similar conditions. Watch **Ka Mate Du Brivet's** early positioning as his inexperience could see him caught wide or too far back in such a small field. **Broomfield Aderra** needs close attention at the start - if he breaks slowly, the pace could become genuinely pedestrian with all three happy to sit back.

races.name: Join Bet St George "Hands And Heels" Handicap Hurdle (ConditionalsAmateurs) (Racing Excellence)
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This shapes as a moderate gallop with Motazzen the sole confirmed front runner over 2m5½f. With only Peking Opera and Vendant likely to track prominently behind the leader, Motazzen won't face early pressure and can dictate terms through steady fractions. The bulk of the field - Geordies Betty, Godot, Wot You Wearing, and Kylenoe Dancer - are committed hold-up merchants who'll settle well off the pace. This creates a classic scenario where the front division gets first run while the back markers face a stern test to make up significant ground from the home turn. Expect the race to develop into a straight fight between those who can travel prominently and time their effort against hold-up horses needing everything to fall right.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS:** Motazzen benefits enormously from this setup - uncontested early means sustainable fractions and first run when it matters. Peking Opera, despite modest recent form, gets the ideal tactical position tracking the leader without doing donkey work. Vendant can also exploit prominent positioning in what should be a truly-run race.

**LOSERS:** The hold-up quartet face a significant disadvantage. Godot and Wot You Wearing particularly suffer as even-pace types needing quick early splits to set up their finishing kick. Kylenoe Dancer has shown finishing ability but gives away too much ground early in this small field. **Geordies Betty is the major going concern** - rated highest but has never raced on good ground, making her completely unpredictable despite obvious class advantages.

## RACE SCENARIOS

**A)** If Motazzen maintains a solid gallop throughout... **Motazzen and Peking Opera** benefit because they can control the race from the front two positions and kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized.

**B)** If the pace collapses with Motazzen going too slow early... **Godot and Kylenoe Dancer** benefit because the hold-up brigade gets closer to the pace and can unleash their finishing kicks in a sprint finish.

**C)** If Geordies Betty handles the good ground... **Geordies Betty dominates** because her superior class rating (proj 79.0 vs next best 70.7) would make this a mismatch regardless of pace dynamics.

## WATCH POINTS

Monitor Geordies Betty pre-race for any handling issues on the good ground - three career runs all came on softer surfaces. Watch for Motazzen's early positioning - if anything tracks him closely early, it could compromise his stamina reserves. Peking Opera needs to avoid getting trapped behind a slow-going Motazzen if the leader's jumping becomes sketchy. The hold-up horses need Motazzen to go off too fast early or collapse late to have realistic winning chances from their back-of-field positions.

races.name: betstgeorge.com Top Prices On English Events Handicap Chase
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race has no confirmed front runner, creating a tactical nightmare. Ronnies Reflection, Daring Plan, Valirann Gold, and Engaging Sam all want prominent positions — that's four horses scrapping for the same real estate early. With the three hold-up horses (Kitsilano, Royal Juniper, Tom Desjy) sitting back, expect a falsely-run affair where the prominent quartet go steady for the first half, then it becomes a sprint from 3-out when nobody wants to commit. The lack of a genuine galloper means this becomes about who can quickest from a standing start in the final half-mile rather than sustained stamina.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS:** Ronnies Reflection sits perfectly — genuine pace-forcing ability (L1 P10 style) in a race crying out for someone to take responsibility. Can dictate terms and has the tactical speed for the sprint finish this will become. Daring Plan also benefits with enough early pace (L2 P8) to secure prime position without the traffic nightmares.

**LOSERS:** The three hold-up horses face a nightmare. Kitsilano, Royal Juniper, and Tom Desjy will be caught flat-footed when the pace quickens — all are even-paced types needing gradual progression, not explosive acceleration from 3-out. Valirann Gold and Engaging Sam risk getting boxed in the prominent congestion with limited escape routes.

**GOING CONCERNS:** Tom Desjy is a complete unknown on this good surface — zero runs on similar going makes him unbackable.

## RACE SCENARIOS

**A)** If Ronnies Reflection takes control early and controls the tempo... Ronnies Reflection and Daring Plan benefit because they can dictate a pace that suits their tactical speed while keeping the hold-up horses too far back to mount serious challenges.

**B)** If the prominent quartet go too steady and create a sprint finish... Kitsilano benefits because despite his hold-up style, his superior OR94 rating gives him the class edge if he can get into contention, though it's against his natural running style.

**C)** If traffic problems develop 2-3 out among the prominent horses... Royal Juniper benefits because as the cleanest hold-up horse, he can sweep widest and capitalize on the prominent horses blocking each other in the sprint.

## WATCH POINTS

Watch Ronnies Reflection in the paddock — his going record on good ground is poor (2/15 runs, no wins or places) despite suiting the pace setup. Valirann Gold and Engaging Sam are prime candidates for getting boxed in with four horses wanting the same prominent spots. Tom Desjy needs avoiding completely until proven on this surface. The widest, clearest path will likely come to whichever hold-up horse (Kitsilano or Royal Juniper) gets positioned on the outside rail approaching the business end.

races.name: England To Win Tonight 20/1 betstgeorge.com Maiden Hurdle (Novices' Champ Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB)
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race lacks any genuine front-runner, creating a tactical nightmare over this extended 2m1½f trip. Unknown Entity and Graeme The Grey are the only horses with prominent tendencies, but both have shown hold-up running previously, making them unreliable pace-setters. Expect a crawling early gallop with jockeys playing cat-and-mouse, before an inevitable sprint finish from the back straight. This false pace completely negates the stamina test that 2m1½f should provide, turning it into a 6-furlong dash for horses carrying significant residual speed.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS:** Jambon benefits enormously as the only horse with genuine front-running capability - he can dictate terms and kick clear when the false pace inevitably quickens. The hold-up quartet of Khalk'eau Spigao, The Quant, Trooper, and I'm Wide Awake are perfectly positioned for the sprint finish this will become.

**LOSERS:** Grizzled Squirrel faces a nightmare scenario - his prominent racing style means he'll be caught in no-man's land when the pace collapses, too far back to influence but too far forward to benefit from the sprint. Unknown Entity and Graeme The Grey risk being caught flat-footed if they're forced into unwanted front-running roles.

**GOING CONCERN:** I'm Wide Awake has never run on good ground, making her completely unreliable despite the tactical setup suiting.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Jambon takes them along at a genuine gallop... Khalk'eau Spigao and The Quant benefit because their hold-up styles thrive when there's genuine pace to aim at.

B) If Unknown Entity gets forced into reluctant front-running... Grizzled Squirrel and Last Round benefit because they can sit closer to a moderate pace and have something left for the finish.

C) If nobody wants the lead and it becomes a crawl... Jambon and any horse with tactical speed benefits because they can quicken off the bridle when the sprint develops.

## WATCH POINTS

Watch the pre-race market moves on I'm Wide Awake - any confidence suggests connections know something about her good ground form that we don't. Jambon's jockey instructions will be crucial - aggressive or patient tactics will shape the entire race. In a small field, positioning around the final turn becomes vital, with Trooper and The Quant needing clear runs from their hold-up styles. The two prominent runners, Unknown Entity and Graeme The Grey, risk being sacrificed if neither wants the lead but both get caught wide tracking each other.

races.name: betstgeorge.com With Daily St George Specials Chase Series Final (A Handicap Chase) (GBB Race)
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race will be run at a sustainable gallop with The Gypsy Davey taking them along from the front without serious pressure. With only one confirmed front runner and three prominent racers (Koenigsstern, Mon Champion, Le Galli Bier) tracking behind, the pace will be honest but not breakneck early. This creates a proper staying test over 2m3½f where the race will likely be won by whichever horse can quicken best from the 3f pole. The four hold-up horses (Alien Storm, Rip Wheeler, Superstylin, Alright Dai) will need the pace to be strong enough to bring them into contention, and with The Gypsy Davey likely controlling things, they should get their chance.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS**: Koenigsstern and Mon Champion are perfectly positioned to benefit from tracking The Gypsy Davey's honest pace, sitting close enough to strike when the tempo lifts. Alien Storm, despite being the highest-rated, could be vulnerable if the pace becomes too sedate early - hold-up horses need something to aim at. 

**LOSERS**: Rip Wheeler faces the worst scenario as a hold-up horse who needs a strong pace, but with only The Gypsy Davey likely to go forward early, there may not be enough tempo. Alright Dai has similar issues but stronger going form (9/15 runs on similar going). Mon Champion's poor going record (just 1/13 runs on Good ground) is a significant concern despite his tactical advantage.

## RACE SCENARIOS

A) If Mon Champion handles the Good going better than his record suggests... Mon Champion and Koenigsstern benefit because they can sit perfectly positioned behind The Gypsy Davey and have the tactical speed to respond when the race develops.

B) If The Gypsy Davey sets too slow a pace early... Alien Storm and Superstylin benefit because their superior class will tell in a sprint finish, with Alien Storm's 128 OR giving him a decisive edge in a tactical battle.

C) If the pace becomes genuinely strong with Koenigsstern or Mon Champion pressing The Gypsy Davey... Rip Wheeler and Alright Dai benefit because the strong gallop will set up perfectly for their hold-up styles to sweep up the pieces late.

## WATCH POINTS

Monitor Mon Champion pre-race - his going record (0 wins from 1 run on similar) suggests he could struggle despite tactical positioning. Watch for Koenigsstern's jumping - prominent horses who make mistakes early get shuffled back into traffic. The Gypsy Davey needs to be allowed his own way in front; if pressed early by the prominent trio, his stamina could give out. Alien Storm requires confident riding from the rear - any hesitation when the gap appears will cost him given the likely modest pace.

races.name: Bet St George Supports Safer Gambling Handicap Hurdle
races.narrative:
## PACE SCENARIO

This race lacks any confirmed front runners, with only Juggernaut (1 lead from 13 runs) and Test The Market (0 leads from 4 runs) showing any inclination to race prominently early. Neither is a natural pace-setter, creating a classic false pace scenario. Expect these two to dawdle in front through the early stages, with the remaining six runners - Hello Cello, Bridge, Jacquetta, Dr Waksman, Tommy Dillion, and Mistress Fox - all preferring to be held up. This sets up a slowly-run affair that will become a sprint finish from the final hurdle, heavily favoring horses with tactical pace who can position close enough to strike.

## POSITIONAL WINNERS & LOSERS

**WINNERS:** Juggernaut benefits most as the only horse with genuine leading experience (1 lead, 9 prominent) and can control the tempo from the front without pressure. Test The Market, despite no leading experience, has raced prominently in all four career starts and should sit perfectly in second, ideally placed for the sprint finish. Hello Cello, though typically held up, has shown prominent tendencies (3 from 8 runs) and could track the leaders closer than usual.

**LOSERS:** The pure hold-up horses face a nightmare scenario. Dr Waksman (held up in 9 of 10 runs) and Tommy Dillion (held up in 10 of 14 runs) will be caught too far back when the race explodes. Bridge, despite occasional leading ability, has been held up in 8 of 13 recent runs and may struggle to get into contention from the rear. **Going concerns are critical:** Jacquetta and Mistress Fox have zero form on good ground, making them complete unknowns on this surface.

## RACE SCENARIOS

**A)** If Juggernaut kicks clear approaching the final flight... Test The Market and Hello Cello benefit because they'll be closest in pursuit with the tactical pace to respond immediately.

**B)** If Test The Market takes over from Juggernaut turning for home... Juggernaut and any hold-up horse who has managed to get within striking distance like Bridge benefit because Test The Market has never won and may crack under pressure.

**C)** If the pace is even slower than expected with multiple horses tracking close... Dr Waksman and Tommy Dillion benefit because their superior official ratings (100 and 80 respectively) could tell in a true test of stamina rather than speed.

## WATCH POINTS

**Pre-race going check essential** for Jacquetta and Mistress Fox - both have zero form on good ground and represent complete betting unknowns. Watch Juggernaut's early positioning - if he doesn't go forward immediately, this becomes an even more slowly-run race. Test The Market needs to settle prominently but not be forced into an early lead he can't sustain. Hello Cello's early positioning will be crucial - any sign of prominent intent makes him a major player. Dr Waksman and Tommy Dillion need to be ridden for luck from the rear and will require clear runs at crucial moments.
